note: Sanitized mflux profiles for local image generation. This is a separate layer from the oMLX profiles in omlx-profiles.json: oMLX serves the text LLMs, mflux runs the diffusion models. No API keys or secrets included.

klein-q8.name: klein-q8
klein-q8.license_note: Apache-2.0. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

quantization.note: The level is stored in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed.

klein-q8.compute_precision_note: Apple M1 family has no native bfloat16, so MLX's matmul and attention kernels are fastest in float16. The residual stream, norms, text encoder and VAE keep the model's own precision. On an M1 Max mflux measured FLUX.2 klein 4B (q4) at 6.8 -> 5.0 s/step (-22%) with this flag. It changes the image slightly for a given seed, so a run records it.

klein-q4.name: klein-q4
klein-q4.description: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, MLX 4-bit, 4-step distilled. Apache-2.0. The q8 profile's half-size sibling: same model and CLI, weights quantized one step further.
klein-q4.license_note: Apache-2.0. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

quantization.note: The level is stored in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed.

klein-q4.compute_precision_note: Apple M1 family has no native bfloat16, so MLX's matmul and attention kernels are fastest in float16. The residual stream, norms, text encoder and VAE keep the model's own precision. It changes the image slightly for a given seed, so a run records it.
klein-q4.benchmark_note: 23.8 s/img measured 2026-11-17 (mean of the seven steady-state images, the first dropped for model load). Eight prompts, 22.8-25.2 s. Data: reference/image-benchmark-klein-q4.json. +1.3 s (+5.8%) slower than the 8-bit klein-q8, because the 4-bit weights are dequantised on the fly; the saving is disk and memory, not seconds.

z-image-turbo-q4.name: z-image-turbo-q4
z-image-turbo-q4.description: Z-Image Turbo, MLX 4-bit (mflux-community q4), 9-step distilled. Apache-2.0.
z-image-turbo-q4.license_note: Apache-2.0. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

quantization.note: The level is stored in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed.

z-image-turbo-q4.compute_precision_note: No compute_precision is set: mflux 0.38.0 (via mlx-gen 0.38.0) no longer accepts --compute-precision, so the harness passes no precision flag for this profile. Z-Image Turbo is a distilled 9-step model and does not need it.

bonsai-image-ternary-2bit.name: bonsai-image-ternary-2bit
bonsai-image-ternary-2bit.description: Bonsai Image 4B, ternary 1.58-bit g128 (MLX 2-bit deployment). Apache-2.0. Runs through mlx-gen, not mflux: it is an MLX-Gen saved-weight package of the FLUX.2 Klein 4B architecture with no mflux console script.
bonsai-image-ternary-2bit.license_note: Apache-2.0, inherited from the base model. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

quantization.note: Ternary values {-,0,+} with one FP16 scale per 128-weight group (1.58-bit g128). The level is stored in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed. The text encoder is a separate MLX 4-bit directory.

bonsai-image-ternary-2bit.compute_precision_note: No compute_precision is set: mflux 0.38.0 (via mlx-gen 0.38.0) no longer accepts --compute-precision, and the mlx-gen CLI has no such flag. The model is designed for 4 steps at guidance 1.0 (FlowMatch-Euler, shift 3.0).

ernie-image-turbo-q8.license_note: Apache-2.0, inherited from the source model. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

ernie-image-turbo-q8.compute_precision_note: No compute_precision is set: mflux 0.38.0 (via mlx-gen 0.38.0) no longer accepts --compute-precision, and the mlx-gen CLI has no such flag. The uploader's own example runs 8 steps at guidance 1.

qwen-image-4bit.name: qwen-image-4bit
qwen-image-4bit.description: Qwen-Image, MLX mixed q4/q8 MLX-Gen saved weights. Apache-2.0. Runs through mlx-gen; the weights use the mflux/MLX saved-weight layout and are not a Diffusers from_pretrained checkpoint.
qwen-image-4bit.license_note: Apache-2.0, inherited from the source model. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

quantization.note: Mixed q4/q8 policy: the transformer is 4-bit while the uploader keeps the sensitive text_encoder and vae layers at 8-bit. The level is stored in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed.

qwen-image-4bit.compute_precision_note: No compute_precision is set: mflux 0.38.0 (via mlx-gen 0.38.0) no longer accepts --compute-precision, and the mlx-gen CLI has no such flag.
